A production note can explain why the prop is dangerous: it combines an urgent headline, a precise-looking location, an unnamed insider, an alleged cover-up, a vulnerable audience, and an instruction to share. For a media-literacy handout, learners can mark emotional language, missing attribution, unsupported certainty, stale images, and requests for immediate sharing, then rewrite the item as a cautious update that directs readers to official channels.
